question: Does the already declared X20 quotient carry enough independently specified structure to decide an adjacency- and D5-preserving bijection into the unique connected four-five-orbit interface of the frozen Q106 graph?

source_carrier.warning: P4 is used by the parent as a four-package index set. No graph adjacency on P4 or X20 is declared.

target_carrier.carrier: the unique connected Q106 invariant union of four five-node D5 orbits
target_carrier.adjacency: induced undirected support of the frozen 180 directed Q106 edges
target_carrier.actions: frozen D5 permutations r and m

decision_rules.typed_intertwiner: requires a bijection iota preserving declared source adjacency, target adjacency, rotation and the selected reflection/Janus law
decision_rules.d5_equivariant_bijection_count: 4! after j_X and target m are declared
decision_rules.undefined_contract: if source adjacency or edge types are null, adjacency preservation is undecidable and typed_intertwiner_to_q106 remains null
decision_rules.negative_result: if a declared source graph exists and no candidate preserves it, report NO_INTERTWINER
decision_rules.positive_result: only a fully checked map may populate typed_intertwiner_to_q106

comparators: Cartesian product graph C5 square P4
stop_rule: Stop before importing Q106 adjacency back into X20, interpreting P4 as a path graph without a source declaration, selecting one of the 24 D5-equivariant charts, choosing beta or a historical Janus law, or treating Triple-19 Pc/Pd compatibility as established.
claim_boundary: formal finite audit of already frozen records only
no new Study, Family, carrier identity, canonical count or publication state
equivariance without adjacency preservation is not a graph intertwiner
a coordinate chart on the target interface is not a source-derived X20 map
Triple-19 remains related and non-identical until a typed carrier map is supplied
